career.label: 💼 CAREER (Cybersecurity + Employed Individual)
career.filter_hint: Two things merged: (1) Cybersecurity vulnerabilities, breaches, advisories, SOC/blue-team relevant news - exclude generic 'AI safety' or big-tech policy unless directly security-related. (2) Practical updates for a salaried Indian employee - tax rules, labor law changes, government scheme updates, compliance deadlines.
career.notes: Merged from cybersecurity + employed_individual. CERT-In has no reliable public RSS (checked) - skipped, major advisories get picked up by THN/BleepingComputer anyway. EPFO/Income Tax Dept scraping deferred - add later if gaps noticed.

finance.label: 💰 FINANCE (India + Global)
finance.filter_hint: Finance news affecting individuals - markets, RBI policy, interest rates, major global economic shifts. Exclude stock tips/day-trading noise.
finance.notes: EPFO skipped for v1 - major announcements (PF interest rate, withdrawal rules) get covered by these finance sources same-day. Reuters dropped - no public RSS since 2020.

india_news.label: 🇮🇳 INDIA NEWS
india_news.filter_hint: General India news - politics, policy, civic affairs, major events. Strictly exclude celebrity gossip, entertainment, sports scores.
india_news.notes: PeekTV YouTube added as independent media counterweight - title-only since it's video-based. PeekTV Newsletter and The Wire added via KTN - full text content, no title-only limitation.

world_news.label: 🌍 WORLD NEWS
world_news.filter_hint: Major world news - geopolitics, global events with broad relevance. Brief, headline-level only.
world_news.notes: Reuters dropped - no public RSS since 2020 (confirmed). AP News has no clean public RSS either, skipped. BBC + Al Jazeera give good coverage breadth (Western + Middle East-based perspective).

venture.label: 🎬 VENTURE (AI & Content Creation)
venture.filter_hint: AI video/image generation tool updates (Kling, LTX, Flux, Runway, Leonardo, etc.), YouTube creator platform changes, content monetization policy. Exclude general AI research, benchmark wars, big-tech AI politics/drama.
venture.notes: Renamed from ai_content_creation. For AI YouTube channel business tracking. Consider adding YouTube Creator Insider blog once identified. Instagram/X caption scraping ruled out - no free official API access for third-party public profiles (confirmed).

ongoing_events.label: 🔥 ON-GOING EVENTS
ongoing_events.filter_hint: Temporary, event-specific tracking. Whatever sources are listed here are tied to an active, time-bound situation - remove the source once the event concludes.

sources.name: Cockroach Janta Party protests (Google News search)

ongoing_events.notes: Add/remove sources here as events arise and resolve. This category is meant to stay temporary - periodically review and clear out concluded events.
